description: List a user's Morpho Blue market positions, filterable by chain. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

chain_ids.description: Only positions on these chains (comma-delimited). Defaults to every exposed chain.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100, at most 100.

name: morpho_get_market_positions

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

borrow_apy.description: Current market borrow APY, rewards excluded, as a fraction (0.05 = 5%). Null when the realtime store has no state for the market; an infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

borrow_assets.description: Borrowed amount in loan token base units, from the borrow shares at the latest indexed share price.

borrow_assets_usd.description: USD value of `borrow_assets`. Null, never 0, when `borrow_assets` is not 0 and the loan token has no price.

collateral_asset.description: Collateral token metadata and price. Null for an idle market, whose collateral token is the zero address.

logo_uri.description: Token logo URI, or null if unknown.

price_usd.description: Current USD price, null when the pricing service has none.

symbol.description: Token symbol, or null if unknown.

collateral_assets.description: Collateral deposited, in collateral token base units.

collateral_assets_usd.description: USD value of `collateral_assets`. Null for an idle market and, when `collateral_assets` is not 0, when the collateral token has no price.

collateral_value_assets.description: Value of `collateral_assets` in loan token base units at the market oracle price. Null when the realtime store has no oracle price for the market.

health_factor.description: Collateral value times LLTV over borrowed assets. Null when the position has no debt or no oracle price is known.

logo_uri.description: Token logo URI, or null if unknown.

price_usd.description: Current USD price, null when the pricing service has none.

symbol.description: Token symbol, or null if unknown.

supply_apy.description: Current market supply APY, rewards excluded, as a fraction (0.05 = 5%). Null when the realtime store has no state for the market; an infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

supply_assets.description: Supplied amount in loan token base units, from the supply shares at the latest indexed share price.

supply_assets_usd.description: USD value of `supply_assets`. Null, never 0, when `supply_assets` is not 0 and the loan token has no price.
